note: Git reviewer in the registered author checkout. Pause edits while it runs. Use only git_review_binding; no snapshots or full diff artifact are required. Both commits can be HEAD for purely uncommitted review.

task.goal: Review the bound Git changes, including staged, unstaged and nonignored new files. Report findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding states a file/line reference, impact and reason.
Confirmed findings are delivered in the findings artifact.
task.context: Read-only review in your cwd. Use Git and read relevant files. Do not modify, stage or commit. Report findings first with file/line, impact and reason.
checks: List findings with file/line, impact and reason; state explicitly what could not be verified.
